prompt: Build the account area for 'Ledger', a document manager. Requirements: (1) Signed-in views sit in a sidebar + sticky-header app shell. (2) When signed out, show a sign-in screen: ONE centred card carrying the brand, an email field, a password field, and a single primary submit — with no nav bar and no footer on that screen. Submitting a well-formed email signs in; a sign-out control in the shell returns to it. (3) A settings page whose rows each have a name, a one-line description, and exactly ONE control on the right (a theme select and a compact-rows toggle), grouped under quiet headings. (4) A danger zone containing a delete-account action that asks for confirmation in a dialog before doing anything — a single click must never delete. (5) A search page over at least 8 hardcoded documents with a search box that narrows them; when the search matches nothing, show an empty state whose action clears the search rather than offering to create a first document. (6) A states page showing all four states of a data view side by side: the loading skeleton, the empty state, an error state whose action retries, and a 404 whose action navigates away. Use client-side state only (no router, no new dependencies), style with Tailwind token utilities, and keep `npm run build` passing.
